notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Google Dork targeting Azure Blob Storage URLs (.blob.core.windows.net). Same concept as AWS S3 dork — publicly accessible Azure storage containers indexed by Google. Company name or abbreviation in intext: value.

=== CHAINING ===
Identify Azure blob URL from dork → attempt direct access → check for anonymous read permission → enumerate container contents → look for sensitive files.

=== DETECTION SIGNAL ===
Azure blob URLs appearing in source code (link prefetch hints, CDN references) are another discovery path — check page source of target web applications for blob.core.windows.net references.
